label: run3_reduced
method: V_T/C_D computed by replaying the captured dt sequence through the REAL deploy/crash_monitor.py SampleStreamGuard+WindowScorer state machine (synthetic sensor values -- scoring/invalidation is purely timing-driven). Contiguous-run analysis uses the same max_dt_s gap threshold as the deployed guard. '90-sample 3-window confirmation' approximates the real 3-consecutive-anomalous-window TriggerPolicy requirement as needing window_samples + 2*stride_samples=90 contiguous valid samples -- a necessary but not fully sufficient condition (it also requires all 3 windows to be classified anomalous, which is data-dependent and out of scope for this purely-timing analysis).
